cohort: The participants were families in rural areas who reported negative perceptions of CS at baseline.
finding: Music storytelling communication intervention significantly improved positive perceptions and acceptance of caesarean section compared to non-music storytelling, with sustained effects and a lower relapse rate after six months.
mod_finding: Music storytelling communication intervention led to significantly higher positive perceptions and acceptance of caesarean section (CS) as a delivery option, and a lower relapse rate for CS acceptance compared to non-music storytelling communication intervention.
